content.content:
PASS=0
FAIL=0
while IFS=$'\t' read -r status name detail; do
    [[ -z "$status" ]] && continue
    if [[ "$status" == "PASS" ]]; then
        PASS=$((PASS + 1))
        echo -e "  ${GREEN}PASS${NC}  $name"
    else
        FAIL=$((FAIL + 1))
        echo -e "  ${RED}FAIL${NC}  $name"
        [[ -n "$detail" ]] && echo -e "        ${YELLOW}$detail${NC}"
    fi
done < "$OUT"

TOTAL=$((PASS + FAIL))
